metadata.description: A Kafka Connect sink connector allowing data stored in Apache Kafka to be uploaded to Celonis Execution Management System (EMS) for process mining and execution automation

license.reuse_assessment: APPROVED - Can be freely reused, modified, and integrated into proprietary systems. Apache 2.0 is permissive and business-friendly.
conditions: License and copyright notice must be included
State changes if modifications are made

requirements.celonis_platform: Celonis EMS with Continuous Batch Processing API access
infrastructure: Kafka Connect cluster (standalone or distributed mode)
Network access to Celonis Cloud endpoints

data_flow: Kafka Topics → Kafka Connect → Record Transformation → Parquet Buffer → Celonis EMS (CBP API)

EmsSinkConnector.responsibility: Entry point for the Kafka Connect framework, manages connector lifecycle and configuration

EmsSinkTask.responsibility: Processes records from Kafka topics with timeout support (v1.8.1+)

RecordTransformer.responsibility: Transforms incoming Kafka records into AVRO format for Parquet file creation
features: Schema inference for JSON formatted topics (null schema handling)
Default flattening strategy for nested structures

WriterManager.responsibility: Entry point for file-based record buffering logic
features: Dispatches write operations to appropriate Writer instances
Coordinates Parquet file creation and lifecycle

Writer.responsibility: Handles actual writing of records to Parquet files

SchemaInferringJsonConverter.responsibility: Dynamically infers schema from JSON structure and converts to canonical internal representation
SchemaInferringJsonConverter.use_case: Topics with JSON data but no explicit schema

stages.description: Kafka Connect framework pulls records from configured topics
Records are transformed to AVRO GenericRecord format
operations: Error handling with optional DLQ routing

stages.description: AVRO records are written to temporary Parquet files per partition
operations: Parquet file creation with configurable row groups

stages.description: Completed Parquet files are uploaded to Celonis EMS via CBP API
Local Parquet files are cleaned or renamed based on configuration

parallelization_model.concurrency: Tasks can run in parallel across Kafka Connect workers
scalability_considerations: Number of tasks should not exceed number of partitions
Each task maintains separate Writers for its assigned partitions
Distributed mode allows horizontal scaling across workers

consumer_pattern.description: Connector leverages Kafka Connect's built-in consumer group management

commit_triggers: Based on connector's internal batching logic

topic_consumption.partition_assignment: Kafka Connect handles partition assignment to tasks

latency_characteristics.real_time_definition: Near real-time streaming with configurable micro-batches

batching_strategy.trigger_logic: Whichever threshold is reached first triggers upload

row_group_size.impact: Smaller values = more row groups, larger values = more memory usage

network_optimization.strategy: Local file accumulation reduces network calls
network_optimization.benefit: Batch uploads instead of per-record network calls

transformation_pipeline.rationale: AVRO facilitates interaction with Java Parquet libraries

schema_inference.trigger: When incoming SinkRecord has null schema
schema_inference.description: Dynamically infers schema from JSON structure

features: Optional field preservation during evolution (v1.8.6+ fix)
limitations: Data misalignment between file and target table schema can cause failures
Limited error reporting for schema mismatches

schema_registry.configuration: Standard Kafka Connect schema registry settings

flattening_strategy.description: Default flattening strategy applies simple rules for nested structures

operations.description: Nested objects are flattened with underscore separators
Arrays are processed according to simple flattening rules
operations.limitations: Complex array structures may require custom SMTs

operations.description: AVRO enum values are converted to plain strings (v1.8.6+)
operations.benefit: Enables efficient Parquet upload for record-name-strategy AVRO topics with incompatible enum types

flattening_strategy.customization: Can be extended through Kafka Connect Single Message Transforms (SMTs)

data_type_mapping.avro_to_parquet: Native mapping via Parquet Java library

scaling_units: Number of partitions in source topics
best_practices: tasks.max should not exceed number of topic partitions
Monitor worker CPU and memory usage

partition_parallelism.description: WriterManager creates one Writer instance per partition
partition_parallelism.scalability: Linear scaling with partition count (up to task limit)

configuration_impact: Number of partitions multiplies per-partition memory

network.pattern: Batch uploads to minimize network calls

scalability_issue.description: Scaling to 3 instances with 3-partition topics resulted in data count mismatch in Celonis
scalability_issue.impact: Potential data loss or duplication during scaling
scalability_issue.recommendation: Thoroughly test scaling scenarios with data validation

commit_size_reduction.benefit: Enables smaller batch sizes for lower latency use cases

row_group_optimization.benefit: Better balance between memory usage and file efficiency

behavior_when_true: Connector continues processing when single record transformation fails
Failed records are sent to DLQ if configured
Prevents connector failure due to individual bad records
continue_on_invalid_input.use_case: Production environments where uptime is critical

put_timeout.description: Timeout for put operations with e2e tests
put_timeout.benefit: Prevents indefinite blocking on slow operations

offset_management.recovery: On restart, resumes from last committed offset

partial_failure_handling.batch_level: If batch upload fails, entire batch is retried
partial_failure_handling.record_level: Individual record failures can be isolated with continue.on.invalid.input

connector_restart.temporary_files: May need cleanup depending on when failure occurred
connector_restart.state_recovery: Kafka Connect framework manages connector state

parquet_file_retention.purpose: Retain local Parquet files for inspection

schema_mismatch.symptom: Celonis platform job fails during ingestion
schema_mismatch.cause: Incoming file data and schema not aligned with target table schema
schema_mismatch.limitation: No error reporting from connector for this scenario

flattening_bugs.issue: Bug when schema has nested schema

development_dependencies.testing_frameworks: Implied but not detailed in available documentation

schema_on_read.description: Schema inference for schemaless JSON data
schema_on_read.use_case: Flexible ingestion from sources without rigid schemas

circuit_breaker_like.description: Error policies control connector behavior on failures

graceful_degradation.description: Continue processing valid records despite individual failures

canonical_data_model.description: Standardize all inputs to common format before output

flattening_transformation.description: Transform nested structures to flat representation

functional_requirements.requirement: System shall consume messages from Kafka topics in real-time
System shall transform Kafka records to AVRO format
System shall buffer transformed records in Parquet files
System shall upload Parquet files to Celonis EMS via CBP API
System shall infer schemas from JSON messages without explicit schema
System shall flatten nested data structures
System shall route failed records to Dead Letter Queue when configured
System shall retry failed upload operations based on configuration
System shall support multiple data formats (JSON, AVRO, String)
System shall maintain partition ordering from source topics
System shall commit offsets only after successful upload

non_functional_requirements.requirement: System shall achieve near real-time latency (seconds to minutes)
System shall scale horizontally via Kafka Connect distributed mode
System shall provide at-least-once delivery guarantee
System shall handle connector restarts without data loss
System shall be configurable for latency vs. throughput trade-offs
System shall minimize network overhead through batch uploads
System shall be available as open-source under Apache 2.0 license
System shall support deployment on JVM-compatible platforms
System shall provide configurable error handling policies
System shall support debugging through Parquet file retention

integration_requirements.requirement: System shall integrate with Apache Kafka 2.3 or higher
System shall integrate with Kafka Connect framework
System shall integrate with Celonis EMS Continuous Batch Processing API
System shall optionally integrate with Confluent Schema Registry

security_requirements.requirement: System shall authenticate to Celonis API using API keys
System shall use HTTPS for API communication
System shall protect sensitive configuration parameters

Ensure target table schema is aligned before deployment
Monitor Kafka Connect JMX metrics
Track Celonis platform job success/failure
Enable debug.keep.parquet.files initially for troubleshooting
Set up alerts for connector failures and restarts
Secure API keys using Kafka Connect secrets management
Ensure HTTPS for all Celonis API calls
Restrict access to temporary file directory
Regular rotation of API credentials
Validate schema compatibility with target tables
Test scaling scenarios with data validation (issue #9)
Test schema evolution scenarios
Verify error handling with intentionally bad data

summary.overall_assessment: The Celonis Kafka EMS Connector is a well-designed, production-grade connector that demonstrates best practices for Kafka Connect sink implementations. Its Apache 2.0 license makes it an excellent candidate for code reuse and learning. The architecture, particularly the RecordTransformer, WriterManager, and batching logic, provides valuable patterns applicable to other data integration scenarios. The connector is actively maintained with regular releases addressing bugs and adding features. Primary concerns are the reported scalability issue and the Celonis-specific nature of the implementation. For building similar connectors or learning Kafka Connect patterns, this codebase offers significant value.
summary.reuse_verdict: HIGHLY RECOMMENDED for reuse, adaptation, and learning
